metadata.question: Is the forest loss from 2015 to 2022 larger than that from 2000 to 2015 at Macaya National Park?

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Macaya National Park, Haiti (approximate polygon)
macaya = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [-74.05, 18.30], [-74.00, 18.30], 
    [-74.00, 18.35], [-74.05, 18.35], 
    [-74.05, 18.30]
]])

# 2. Data Acquisition - Hansen Global Forest Change
hansen = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_10')

# Check if dataset exists (always should, but verify)
if hansen.bandNames().size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("Hansen dataset not found.")
    print("<answer>D</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Create forest mask (treecover2000 >= 30%)
    treecover = hansen.select('treecover2000')
    forest_mask = treecover.gte(30)  # 30% tree cover threshold
    
    # 4. Extract loss for two periods
    loss_band = hansen.select('loss')
    
    # Period 1: 2000-2015 (loss years 1-15)
    loss_2000_2015 = loss_band.gte(1).And(loss_band.lte(15))
    loss_2000_2015_masked = loss_2000_2015.updateMask(forest_mask)
    
    # Period 2: 2015-2022 (loss years 16-22)
    loss_2015_2022 = loss_band.gte(16).And(loss_band.lte(22))
    loss_2015_2022_masked = loss_2015_2022.updateMask(forest_mask)
    
    # 5. Calculate pixel counts
    scale = 1000  # 1km scale for efficiency
    
    # Count forest area in 2000 (baseline)
    forest_count = forest_mask.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=macaya,
        scale=scale,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('treecover2000').getInfo()
    
    # Count loss pixels for each period
    loss1_count = loss_2000_2015_masked.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=macaya,
        scale=scale,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('loss').getInfo()
    
    loss2_count = loss_2015_2022_masked.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=macaya,
        scale=scale,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('loss').getInfo()
    
    # 6. Check for valid pixels
    if forest_count is None or loss1_count is None or loss2_count is None:
        print("Calculation returned None.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif forest_count == 0:
        print("No forest pixels in 2000.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif loss1_count == 0 and loss2_count == 0:
        print("No forest loss in either period.")
        print("Forest 2000: {:.0f} pixels".format(forest_count))
        print("Loss 2000-2015: 0, Loss 2015-2022: 0")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")  # No loss > no loss
    else:
        # 7. Calculate annual loss rates
        # Period lengths: 2000-2015 = 15 years, 2015-2022 = 7 years
        annual_loss1 = loss1_count / 15 if loss1_count > 0 else 0
        annual_loss2 = loss2_count / 7 if loss2_count > 0 else 0
        
        # 8. Compare annual loss rates
        print("Forest 2000: {:.0f} pixels".format(forest_count))
        print("Loss 2000-2015: {:.0f} pixels ({:.1f}/yr)".format(loss1_count, annual_loss1))
        print("Loss 2015-2022: {:.0f} pixels ({:.1f}/yr)".format(loss2_count, annual_loss2))
        
        # Validate ranges
        if annual_loss1 < 0 or annual_loss2 < 0 or annual_loss1 > forest_count or annual_loss2 > forest_count:
            print("Invalid loss values (out of range).")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif annual_loss2 > annual_loss1:
            print("2015-2022 annual loss > 2000-2015 annual loss")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("2015-2022 annual loss <= 2000-2015 annual loss")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
